commands.command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; TELE=/tmp/phase2d-resource-short-live.jsonl; test -s "$TELE"; python3 - "$TELE" <<'PY'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]
print('sample_count=',len(rows))
print('duration_s=',round(rows[-1]['device_uptime_s']-rows[0]['device_uptime_s'],3))
print('call_states=',sorted({r['call_state'] for r in rows}))
print('call_assistant_states=',sorted({r['call_assistant_state'] for r in rows}))
assert len(rows)>=20
assert rows[-1]['device_uptime_s']-rows[0]['device_uptime_s'] >= 45
assert {r['call_state'] for r in rows} == {2}
app=[r['app'] for r in rows if r.get('app')]
helper=[r['helper'] for r in rows if r.get('helper')]
assert len(app)==len(rows)
assert len(helper)==len(rows)
assert len({x['pid'] for x in app})==1
assert len({x['pid'] for x in helper})==1
def report(name,seq):
    first,last=seq[0],seq[-1]
    peak={k:max(x[k] for x in seq) for k in ('vmrss_kb','fd_count','thread_count')}
    print(name+'_pid=',first['pid'])
    print(name+'_rss_start_end_peak_delta=',first['vmrss_kb'],last['vmrss_kb'],peak['vmrss_kb'],last['vmrss_kb']-first['vmrss_kb'])
    print(name+'_fd_start_end_peak_delta=',first['fd_count'],last['fd_count'],peak['fd_count'],last['fd_count']-first['fd_count'])
    print(name+'_threads_start_end_peak_delta=',first['thread_count'],last['thread_count'],peak['thread_count'],last['thread_count']-first['thread_count'])
    assert last['fd_count'] <= first['fd_count'] + 4
    assert last['thread_count'] <= first['thread_count'] + 4
    assert last['vmrss_kb'] <= first['vmrss_kb'] + 16384
report('app',app)
report('helper',helper)
print('resource_trend_postmortem_green=true')
PY
 test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 0; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 1; test -z "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge:call_media 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo milestone_d_resource_evidence_green=true
